This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. ## About Speak\_

Speak\_ simplifies the hiring process with AI-powered tools that automatically review and score resumes based on your custom signals. With Speak\_, recruiters can quickly identify the best candidates without spending hours manually reading through every application. It integrates smoothly with popular recruiting software like Lever, making it easy to find top talent efficiently.

## Speak\_ features

The Speak\_ integration with Lever allows users to sync all of their jobs, set custom signals for each role, and then use AI to evaluate all applicants based on their potential fit. From within Speak\_, users can quickly review applicants and move them through the hiring pipeline, advancing and archiving candidates as needed.
